name: Capture to Obsidian
description: Sends selected text to a note in Obsidian. Requires the free "Advanced URI" community plugin, installed and enabled in Obsidian's Community Plugins settings.

options.label: Vault Name
options.description: Vault name: the exact name of your Obsidian vault (case-sensitive), shown in Obsidian's vault switcher. Required.

options.label: Note Name
options.description: Note name: the specific note to capture into — not a folder, though you can prefix a folder path, e.g. Inbox/Clippings. Leave blank to use today's Daily Note instead.

options.label: Heading
options.description: Heading: an existing heading in that note to insert captures under. Leave blank to just append to the end of the file.

options.label: Always create a new file
options.description: When on, each capture creates its own new file instead of being appended to the note above.

options.label: Include source app
options.description: Adds a line noting which app the text was copied from.

options.label: Include timestamp
options.description: Prefixes the capture with the current time, e.g. "- 17:58 ...".
